data.name: Niyaz
data.gender_notes: Niyaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: performing the daily acts of worship
data.long_meaning: A person whose life revolves around performing the daily acts of worship in Islam, such as Salah (prayer), Zakat (charity), and Sawm (fasting during Ramadan). The name Niyaz carries the meaning “performing the daily acts of worship” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Niyaz usually hope their child will grow to embody performing the daily acts of worship and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is destined to lead a life deeply rooted in faith and spiritual practices, inspired by the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
data.etymology: Niyaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “performing the daily acts of worship.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niyaz total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: نياز
in_arabic.long_meaning: نياز هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي نяз، والذي يعني العبادة والتقرب إلى الله، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي لوصف العبادة والتواصل مع الله، وله أهمية كبيرة في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: نیاز
in_urdu.meaning: عبادت اور خدا کی طرف سے قربت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نیاز ایک نام ہے جو عربي جڑ نяз سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عبادت اور خدا کی طرف سے قربت، اس نام کا استعمال اسلامی تاریخ میں عبادت اور خدا سے رابطے کے لیے کیا گیا ہے، اور اسے جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان روایت میں بھی اہمیت دی جاتی ہے

in_hindi.name: नियाज
in_hindi.meaning: उपासना और भगवान की ओर से निकटता
in_hindi.long_meaning: नियाज एक नाम है जो अरबी मूल नяз से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है उपासना और भगवान की ओर से निकटता, इस नाम का उपयोग इस्लामी इतिहास में उपासना और भगवान से संपर्क के लिए किया गया है, और इसका महत्व भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में भी है

It is a reminder of one's responsibility to continually seek Allah's pleasure and to strive towards constantly improving one's character and actions, aligning them with the teachings of the Quran and the Sunnah (the traditions of the Prophet Muhammad). By focusing on performing daily acts of worship, an individual can nurture their relationship with Allah, cultivate inner peace, and contribute positively to their community. Ultimately, the pursuit of Niyaz reflects the exalted goal of seeking closeness to Allah and reflecting His divine qualities in one's actions and character.
